# ADAMIS Finance

ADAMIS is a financial education initiative for Primary Education developed by PROSPERE. It combines a digital platform with classroom activities and offers workshops and structured courses for schools.

Canonical site: https://adamis.es/

## Product

ADAMIS combines a guided digital platform with practical classroom activities. Students learn through decisions and experiences, with teacher support throughout the learning journey.

## Methodology

La metodología ADAMIS conecta tres capas: plataforma digital para comprender, actividades de aula para experimentar e IA con supervisión educativa para orientar.

The ADAMIS methodology connects three layers: a digital platform to understand, classroom activities to experience and AI with educational supervision to guide.

## Courses

The current course progression covers three years of Primary Education:

- 4.º / 4th year — Elegir y cuidar / Choose and care.
- 5.º / 5th year — Comparar y planificar / Compare and plan.
- 6.º / 6th year — Decidir y proteger / Decide and protect.

## Impact

The published impact figures are 400 students, 4 schools, 16 workshops or sessions, 16 hours delivered and 16 teachers. More than 95% of participating students say they want to keep learning or repeat the experience.
